reviewScope: Twenty Batch07 authored teaching bridges; content and metadata inspection only

reviews.note: Equal-window range and share-volume compression are correctly separated from any forecast; transfer changes the window length.
270000 divided by 180000 is correctly stated as 1.5; direction and liquidity are explicitly left unresolved.
Range and volume expansion are treated as completed-window observations rather than predicted continuation.
The halt timeline correctly distinguishes a last trade from an executable reopening quote and withholds an unknown reopen price.
Stale and venue-scoped quote evidence is handled without asserting an executable arbitrage opportunity.
One hundred shares times fifty cents correctly yields fifty dollars of planned risk; the lesson does not mislabel it realized loss.
The six-percent move is correct and is taught alongside spread and interval limitations instead of as a tradability verdict.
Only completed pivots support the higher-high and higher-low classification; a new sequence is required for transfer.
Both average-shares-per-trade calculations are correct and the text avoids inferring participant identity or motive.
Availability before the decision cutoff is correctly separated from proof of market causation.
A negative cutoff search is described as an unresolved catalyst rather than proof that no catalyst exists.
Three-point-two minus two yields 1.2 percentage points; matched intervals and alternative explanations are required.
Eighty minus twelve minus eight correctly yields sixty, with exclusions fixed before candidate scoring.
The 09:19:59 cutoff correctly excludes a later 09:25 print and reinforces timestamped no-lookahead scanning.
Zero qualifying records is preserved as a valid result; revised thresholds must be versioned as a different scan.
The percentage-change formula uses the eight-dollar reference denominator and correctly produces 7.5 percent.
Twenty thousand shares times five dollars correctly produces approximately one hundred thousand dollars and retains execution limitations.
Twenty-one minus nineteen yields a two-dollar range and two divided by twenty yields ten percent; one bar is correctly distinguished from ATR.
Security type is established before comparing supply fields, and common stock is not conflated with a warrant.
Eighteen million divided by fifty million correctly yields thirty-six percent; as-of date and stale-data gates remain explicit.
